vocab.why: hire: 고용하다(= employ). 예: Bexley Foods plans to hire ten new delivery drivers this spring.
colleague: 같은 직장의 동료(= coworker). 예: Ms. Park introduced her new colleague at the team meeting.
deliver: 배달하다; (연설 · 발표를) 하다. 명사형은 delivery(배달). 예: The supplier will deliver the printer paper on Thursday.
estimate: 명사로 견적(서) · 추정치, 동사로 추정하다 · 견적을 내다. 예: The contractor sent us an estimate for the office renovation.
ensure: 보장하다, 반드시 ~하게 하다(= make sure). insure(보험에 들다)와 철자가 비슷하므로 주의한다. 예: Please ensure that all windows are closed before you leave the office.
vacancy: (일자리) 공석, (호텔) 빈방. 형용사 vacant(비어 있는)의 명사형이다. 예: We have a vacancy for a sales assistant at our Busan branch.
reimburse: 직원이 먼저 쓴 비용을 회사가 상환하다. 출장비 정산 상황에 자주 나온다. 예: The company will reimburse employees for taxi fares on business trips.
prospective: 장래의, ~이 될 가능성이 있는. prospective clients(잠재 고객) · prospective employees(입사 예정자). 예: We will give a factory tour to prospective buyers next week.
discrepancy: 수치 · 기록 사이의 불일치. 예: The accountant found a discrepancy between the invoice and the delivery receipt.
expedite: (업무 · 배송을) 신속히 처리하다. export(수출하다)와 앞부분만 같다. 예: For an extra fee, we can expedite your order so that it arrives tomorrow.

lc.prompt: When does the shuttle bus to the convention center leave?

lc.prompt: Who's going to take notes at today's budget meeting?

lc.prompt: Where are the extra toner cartridges kept?

lc.prompt: Why did the delivery truck arrive so late this morning?

lc.prompt: Mr. Ibarra is leading the factory tour, isn't he?

lc.prompt: Should we hold the retirement party at the office or at a restaurant?
